articles.title: The Mutations of Machine Speech
articles.abstract: Algorithmic outputs now populate the digital environments through which contemporary life is organized. The role of law in facilitating and constituting (rather than merely responding to) these processes is gaining increasing traction across scholarly accounts. This inquiry traces the evolution of algorithmic outputs attending to their legal underpinnings and social implications, surfacing the mutations of machine speech. The first mutation redefined speech as data to be queried: search engines transformed the web from a space of information retrieval into an economic regime of algorithmic visibility. The second mutation reframed speech as engagement: social media platforms fused moderation with amplification, turning expression into a metric of attention, governed by corporate architectures. The third mutation emerges in conversational systems and interfaces, where generative text displaces information retrieval, bringing with it dense technolegal entanglements and profound epistemic consequences. Scholars of freedom of expression, informational privacy, and communication studies have long grappled with these dynamics, yet their implications for broader legal thought have also become urgent. This piece seeks to organize and clarify the evolving debate around algorithmic speech, making this critical but often fragmented discourse more accessible to wider legal and interdisciplinary audiences. In doing so, it bridges the gap between observing technological transformation and critically assessing the constitutive role of law within it, offering a conceptual resource for researchers, students, policymakers, and practitioners navigating and contesting this evolving landscape.
articles.titleCn: 机器语音的突变
articles.abstractCn: 算法输出如今正充斥着当代社会生活的组织性数字环境。法律在促进和构建（而非仅仅应对）这些过程中的作用，在学术观点中正获得日益广泛的关注。本探究追溯了算法输出的演变，关注其法律基础和社会影响，揭示了机器语言的变异。第一种变异将语言重新定义为可查询的数据：搜索引擎将网络从信息检索空间转变为算法可见性的经济体制。第二种变异将语言重新定义为参与度：社交媒体平台融合了审核与放大，将表达转化为受企业架构调控的注意力指标。第三种变异出现在对话系统和界面中，生成性文本取代了信息检索，带来了密集的技术法律纠缠和深刻的认知后果。言论自由、信息隐私和传播研究的学者们长期以来一直应对这些动态，但它们对更广泛法律思想的影响也变得紧迫。本文旨在组织和阐明围绕算法语言的演变辩论，使这一关键但往往碎片化的论述更容易被更广泛的法律和跨学科受众所理解。通过这样做，它弥合了观察技术转型与批判性地评估法律在其中构成作用之间的差距，为研究人员、学生、政策制定者和实践者提供了概念资源，以应对和挑战这一不断发展的领域。

articles.title: From Fixed Keys to Readable Schemas: Small Language Models for Vehicle Agent Function Calls
articles.abstract: In-vehicle assistants must translate natural-language requests into accurate vehicle function calls under strict memory and latency constraints, making small language models (SLMs) attractive for on-device deployment. For such models, a key design choice is how the available function surface is presented. Two approaches are to represent each function with a dedicated Functional Token (FT) or provide function schemas directly in the prompt. FTs enable compact inference but are restricted to functions learned during training, whereas Schema-in-Prompt (SIP) can generalize to unseen functions at the cost of longer prompts and higher inference overhead. We introduce a benchmark of 9,822 single-turn examples spanning 79 vehicle functions derived from Android Automotive, including held-out functions and requests requiring refusal. We compare both approaches under matched fine-tuning across four SLMs from 270M to 1.7B parameters. On functions seen during training, scaling provides limited benefit: the 270M model can match the 1.7B model, while the strongest overall performance occurs at 0.6B. On held-out functions, FT achieves zero accuracy by construction, whereas SIP generalizes and improves substantially with scale. On out-of-scope requests, FT can invoke an unavailable function it was trained to emit, while SIP more reliably refuses based on the functions offered. This flexibility comes with higher memory use and latency. Our theoretical analysis explains how SIP enables generalization and why longer schema contexts increase inference cost. Overall, function-surface representation, rather than model scale alone, determines the capabilities and failure modes of SLM-based vehicle function calling.
articles.titleCn: 从固定密钥到可读模式：用于车辆代理功能调用的小型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 车载助手必须在严格的内存和延迟限制下将自然语言请求翻译为精确的车辆功能调用，这使得小型语言模型（SLM）在设备上部署具有吸引力。对于这类模型，一个关键的设计选择是如何呈现可用的功能界面。有两种方法：为每个功能分配一个专门的功能标记（FT），或直接在提示中提供功能模式。FT能够实现紧凑的推理，但仅限于训练期间学习到的功能，而提示中嵌入模式（SIP）可以泛化到未见过的功能，但代价是更长的提示和更高的推理开销。我们介绍了一个包含9822个单轮示例的基准，涵盖79种车辆功能，这些功能源自Android Automotive，包括保留功能和需要拒绝的请求。我们在四个参数规模从27M到170B的SLM上进行了匹配微调的比较。在训练期间见过的功能上，扩展带来的收益有限：27M模型可以匹配170B模型，而最强整体性能出现在60B模型。在保留功能上，FT通过设计实现零精度，而SIP能够泛化并随着规模显著提升。在超出范围的请求上，FT可以调用它被训练用来发出但不可用的功能，而SIP更可靠地基于提供的功能进行拒绝。这种灵活性伴随着更高的内存使用和延迟。我们的理论分析解释了SIP如何实现泛化以及为什么更长的模式上下文会增加推理成本。总体而言，功能界面的表示方式，而不仅仅是模型规模，决定了基于SLM的车辆功能调用的能力和失效模式。

articles.title: Edu-QuRating: Multi-Dimensional Educational Data Curation with Distilled Pairwise Judgements
articles.abstract: Educational data filters have become a practical way to improve language-model pre-training, but most filters treat educational value as a single scalar property. This may be too broad for some applications, especially if the data set already features a high density of educational material. Useful learning material needs to be accurate, engaging, well structured, and appropriate for the intended audience and application (e.g. learner- vs teacher-facing). Following QuRating (Wettig et al. 2024), we introduce Edu-QuRating: a pipeline for multi-dimensional educational data scoring and curation. Edu-QuRating defines education-specific rubrics, uses an LLM judge to label sampled document pairs and distills those pairwise preferences into reusable Edu-QuRaters, which can score individual text chunks on a set of educational criteria. Across two sequence-classification base models and six educational criteria, the best Edu-QuRater recovers held-out GPT-4.1-mini pairwise judgements with mean accuracy 0.917. We then apply the resulting scorers in two applications. First, we investigate the potential of Edu-QuRaters for corpus filtering to improve pretraining of small language models. We scored 322.25M FineWeb-Edu-Fortified documents to obtain a filtered pre-training mixture. In matched single-run pre-training comparisons, models trained with Edu-QuRating-based mixtures reached higher observed aggregate accuracy across nine benchmarks than the FineWeb-Edu baseline, with gains concentrated in particular tasks. Second, we used Edu-QuRater scores as reward terms for GRPO post-training. In held-out pairwise judge evaluations, combining Edu-QuRater and answer-structure rewards produced responses preferred to the Qwen3-4B base model on both pedagogical quality and instruction following.
articles.titleCn: Edu-QuRating：基于精炼成对判断的多维教育数据管理
articles.abstractCn: 教育数据过滤器已成为改进语言模型预训练的实用方法，但大多数过滤器将教育价值视为单一标量属性。对于某些应用而言，这可能过于宽泛，特别是当数据集已经包含大量教育材料时。有用的学习材料需要准确、引人入胜、结构良好，并且适合目标受众和应用（例如，面向学习者与教师）。遵循QuRating（Wettig等人，2024年），我们引入了Edu-QuRating：一个用于多维教育数据评分和管理的流程。Edu-QuRating定义了特定于教育的评分标准，使用大型语言模型（LLM）裁判对采样文档对进行标注，并将这些成对偏好提炼为可重用的Edu-QuRaters，这些Edu-QuRaters能够在一系列教育标准上对单个文本片段进行评分。在两个序列分类基础模型和六个教育标准上，最佳的Edu-QuRater以平均准确率0.917恢复了保留的GPT-4.1-mini成对评判。随后，我们将得到的评分器应用于两个应用场景。首先，我们研究了Edu-QuRaters在语料库过滤方面的潜力，以改进小型语言模型的预训练。我们评分了322.25M个FineWeb-Edu-Fortified文档，以获得过滤后的预训练混合物。在匹配的单次运行预训练比较中，使用基于Edu-QuRating混合物训练的模型在九个基准测试中达到了更高的观察总准确率，提升主要体现在特定任务上。其次，我们使用Edu-QuRater评分作为GRPO后训练的奖励项。在保留的成对裁判评估中，结合Edu-QuRater和答案结构的奖励产生的响应在教育学质量和指令遵循方面均优于Qwen3-4B基础模型。

articles.title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Research Across Database Querying and Web Search
articles.abstract: While autonomous agents have made significant strides in "deep research" by iteratively navigating the open web to synthesize information, real-world problem-solving is rarely confined to a single environment. Complex analytical tasks inherently require agents to weave together evidence from both ambiguous unstructured text (e.g., the open web) and highly precise structured data (e.g., relational databases). However, existing benchmarks evaluate these modalities in isolation, failing to capture the critical "handoff" - the ability to preserve constraints when moving evidence between systems. We introduce HybridDeepResearch, to our knowledge the first deep-research benchmark that requires both web search and SQL to form a complete, verifiable answer. The benchmark contains 380 tool-dependent tasks grounded in LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite databases and public web corpora, validated through automated checks and human review, and covering three reasoning patterns: SQL2S, S2SQL, and Parallel. Evaluations across proprietary and open-weight models under various agentic scaffolds reveal that even state-of-the-art models like GLM-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5 achieve only about 50-54% Pass@8 on the hard subset. Notably, results show that directional reasoning is substantially more difficult than parallel intersection, highlighting that bridging structured and unstructured information spaces without losing constraints remains a major open challenge for agentic systems. Code and datasets are publicly available at GitHub (https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch).
articles.titleCn: 跨数据库查询与网络搜索的混合深度研究基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 尽管自主代理通过迭代式在开放网络中导航进行信息综合，在“深度研究”方面取得了显著进展，但现实世界的问题解决很少局限于单一环境。复杂的分析任务本质上要求代理将模糊的非结构化文本证据（例如开放网络）和高精确度的结构化数据（例如关系数据库）相结合。然而，现有的基准测试将这两种模态独立评估，未能捕捉到关键的“交接”能力——即在系统间转移证据时保持约束的能力。我们介绍了HybridDeepResearch，据我们所知，这是首个要求同时使用网络搜索和SQL来形成完整、可验证答案的深度研究基准。该基准包含380个基于LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite数据库和公开网络语料库的工具依赖任务，通过自动化检查和人工审核验证，涵盖三种推理模式：SQL2S、S2SQL和并行。在各种代理框架下对专有和开放权重模型进行的评估表明，即使是GLM-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6和GPT-5等最先进的模型，在困难子集上的Pass@8也仅达到约50-54%。值得注意的是，结果表明定向推理比并行交集难度大得多，突显了在连接结构化和非结构化信息空间而不丢失约束方面，对代理系统而言仍然是一个主要的开放性挑战。代码和数据集已公开发布在GitHub（https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch）和Hugging Face（https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch）。

articles.title: What Does MMLU Actually Measure? A Psychometric Audit of Difficulty Structure in Aggregate Benchmark Scores
articles.abstract: Although MMLU is widely adopted as a benchmark for calibrating general AI capabilities, we psychometrically demonstrate that its aggregate score primarily evaluates a model's factual retrieval capacity rather than its reasoning ability. By calibrating item difficulty for 1,000 open-weights language models over 14,042 MMLU test items using Item Response Theory, we show that evaluating both abilities via a single test is inherently flawed. Difficulty is then regressed on a deterministic, text-extractable framework of structural complexity. Applying a joint Wald test with subject-clustered covariances demonstrates that the MMLU conflates fundamentally separable constructs. The mapping from structural complexity to difficulty is not invariant across the benchmark's STEM and non-STEM partitions. This finding has practical consequences. Aggregate leaderboard ranks track non-STEM accuracy more closely than STEM accuracy, so selecting a Top-50 model on the aggregate for a reasoning-intensive deployment displaces roughly 22% of the STEM-appropriate choices. Furthermore, when controlling for the multiple-choice guessing floor natively inside the response model, we find that higher-ability models continue to degrade more steeply under increased reasoning depth. The MMLU aggregate therefore weights retrieval capacity and reasoning stability unequally, inadvertently favoring models optimized for retrieval. We release our deterministic framework as a reproducible auditing instrument and recommend disaggregated reporting.
articles.titleCn: MMLU究竟衡量什么？对汇总基准分数难度结构的心理测量学审计
articles.abstractCn: 尽管MMLU被广泛用作校准通用人工智能能力的基准，但我们通过心理测量学方法证明，其综合得分主要评估的是模型的事实检索能力，而非推理能力。通过运用项目反应理论，对14,042个MMLU测试项目中的1,000个开放权重语言模型进行难度校准，我们表明通过单一测试评估这两种能力本身就存在根本缺陷。随后将难度回归到一个由结构复杂性决定的、可从文本中提取的确定性框架上。应用具有受试者聚类协方差的联合Wald检验表明，MMLU将本质上可分离的构念混淆在一起。从结构复杂性到难度的映射在基准的STEM和非STEM分区之间并非不变。这一发现具有实际意义。综合排行榜排名更紧密地追踪非STEM准确率而非STEM准确率，因此在综合排行榜上选择一个用于推理密集型部署的Top-50模型，会取代大约22%的STEM适用选择。此外，在控制响应模型中固有的多项选择猜测底线后，我们发现能力更高的模型在推理深度增加时仍然会更快地退化。因此，MMLU的综合得分不等权重地对待检索能力和推理稳定性，无意中偏袒了为检索优化过的模型。我们发布我们的确定性框架作为可复现的审计工具，并建议进行分项报告。

articles.title: Do LLMs Make More Mistakes If They Do Not Believe the Input Data?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinating or misinterpreting facts, which impairs their usability in retrieval-augmented generation or data-to-text systems. We analyse how faithfulness of LLMs to provided context depends on how plausible they perceive the context to be (context-memory conflict). To better identify error patterns, we make use of the increased difficulty of non-English and low-resource language text generation and input data based on local knowledge, only partially captured in models' parametric knowledge. We let the models generate text in English, Czech, Slovak and Upper Sorbian from factual (FA), counterfactual (CFA) and fictional (FI) RDF triples containing local Czech and Slovak data. Contrary to our expectations, we observe only a weak context-memory conflict on the human-annotated sample. For Kimi K3 as an LLM judge, which agrees well with human annotations on the sample, counterfactual inputs receive only slightly lower faithfulness scores than factual ones (-0.05 on a 1-5 scale). We also find that a suboptimal choice of LLM judge would lead to overestimating the strength of the context-memory conflict.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, to be published in INLG 2026
articles.titleCn: 如果大型语言模型不相信输入数据，它们会犯更多错误吗？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）容易产生幻觉或误解事实，这会降低它们在检索增强生成或数据到文本系统中的可用性。我们分析了LLMs对所提供上下文的忠实度如何取决于它们感知上下文的合理性（上下文-记忆冲突）。为了更好地识别错误模式，我们利用了非英语和低资源语言文本生成及基于本地知识输入数据的难度增加，这些知识仅部分被模型的参数化知识所捕捉。我们让模型从包含捷克和斯洛伐克本地数据的真实（FA）、反事实（CFA）和虚构（FI）RDF三元组中生成英语、捷克语、斯洛伐克语和上索布语文本。与我们的预期相反，我们在人工标注样本上观察到只有微弱的上下文-记忆冲突。作为LLM评判者的Kimi K3与人工标注样本高度一致，反事实输入的忠实度得分仅略低于真实输入（在1-5分制上低0.05分）。我们还发现，如果LLM评判者的选择不佳，会导致高估上下文-记忆冲突的强度。

articles.title: Auditable Emergency Triage for Maternal and Newborn Care in India
articles.abstract: At Noora Health, our nurses answer more than 50,000 medical queries per month on our WhatsApp-based service that provides caregivers with on-demand support. Their most time-critical task is emergency triage: deciding which queries need immediate in-person attention. To support them, we built a system that uses a large language model (LLM) to classify whether a message is an emergency and provide a rationale for interpretability. But the system was opaque: analyzing mistakes meant reading reasoning chains for each message, which is infeasible at our scale. Prompt changes meant re-running a full evaluation to prevent regressions, which was both costly and operationally challenging. Clinicians follow a decision tree to make this call, but it was never documented or passed to the model, which relied on a flat list of danger signs. To address these issues, we decomposed triage into two steps: an LLM extracts canonical symptoms and patient context from the query using a clinician-authored vocabulary, and a deterministic rule engine captures the scenarios that indicate an emergency. We show that the new system raised recall from 0.565 to 0.810 and F1 from 0.606 to 0.702, with structured rules driving most of the accuracy gains while the decomposition provides auditability: clinical experts can inspect each stage of the new system to see whether the query was mistranslated, symptoms were incorrectly extracted, patient context was wrongly inferred, or the necessary rules were missing. They can add new rules independently without causing regressions and avoid running costly evaluations. Since deployment, the new system has triaged 152,421 patient queries and flagged 28,535 (18.7%) as emergencies. The over-escalation rate has been 17.8%, without any increase in missed emergencies. Clinicians have also added 48 new rules since deployment, evidence of the faster correction loop we set out to build.
articles.titleCn: 印度母婴护理的审计性紧急分诊
articles.abstractCn: 在Noora Health，我们的护士每月通过基于WhatsApp的服务回答超过50,000个医疗问题，为护理人员提供即时支持。他们最紧迫的任务是紧急分诊：判断哪些问题需要立即的现场关注。为了支持他们，我们构建了一个系统，该系统使用大型语言模型（LLM）对消息是否为紧急情况进行分类，并提供解释性理由。但该系统不透明：分析错误意味着需要阅读每条消息的推理链，这在我们的规模下是不可行的。提示更改意味着需要重新运行完整评估以防止回归，这既昂贵又具有运营挑战。临床医生遵循决策树来做出判断，但从未被记录或传递给模型，该模型依赖于一个危险信号平面列表。为了解决这些问题，我们将分诊分解为两个步骤：LLM使用临床医生编写的词汇从查询中提取规范症状和患者背景，而确定性规则引擎捕获指示紧急情况的场景。我们证明，新系统将召回率从0.565提高到0.810，F1从0.606提高到0.702，结构化规则驱动了大部分准确率提升，而分解提供了可审计性：临床专家可以检查新系统的每个阶段，以查看查询是否被误译、症状是否被错误提取、患者背景是否被错误推断，或必要的规则是否缺失。他们可以独立添加新规则，而不会导致回归，并避免运行昂贵评估。自部署以来，新系统已经分诊了152,421个患者查询，并标记了28,535个（18.7%）为紧急情况。过度升级率为17.8%，而未出现紧急情况遗漏。临床医生自部署以来还添加了48条新规则，这是我们试图构建的更快纠正循环的证据。

articles.title: SWORD: Wikidata-based Distortions Reveal Hidden Cross-Lingual Inconsistencies in LLM Factual Error Rejection
articles.abstract: Modern LLMs demonstrate impressive multilingual performance, yet standard benchmarks primarily reward selecting correct answers rather than evaluating genuine factual understanding. We introduce Systematic Wikidata-based Object-Relation Distortion (SWORD), a benchmark that evaluates whether models consistently reject factual errors across languages. SWORD generates syntactically well-formed but factually incorrect statements in eight widely spoken languages through controlled perturbations of Wikidata triples, ranging from random entity substitutions to semantically plausible property-based selections. Our distortion-based evaluation surfaces two critical insights that remain entirely obscured by conventional benchmarks. First, models counterintuitively achieve higher accuracy on semantically plausible distortions than on nonsensical random substitutions, suggesting reliance on distributional familiarity rather than genuine factual verification. Second, models exhibiting comparable baseline accuracy across languages show substantial performance degradation specifically on (East) Asian languages when presented with distorted statements, with cross-lingual performance gaps reaching up to 28 percentage points (49\% relative reduction) in some models. These findings demonstrate that multilingual factual reasoning involves asymmetric capabilities that aggregate accuracy metrics systematically obscure.
articles.titleCn: 基于Wikidata的SWORD：扭曲揭示大型语言模型事实性错误拒绝中的隐藏跨语言不一致性
articles.abstractCn: 现代大型语言模型展现出令人印象深刻的跨语言性能，但标准基准测试主要奖励选择正确答案，而非评估真正的理解能力。我们引入了基于维基数据的系统化对象-关系扭曲测试（SWORD），这是一个评估模型是否能在不同语言中始终拒绝事实性错误的基准。SWORD通过控制性地扭曲维基数据三元组，在八种广泛使用的语言中生成语法正确但事实错误陈述，扭曲方式从随机实体替换到语义上合理的属性选择不等。基于扭曲的评估揭示了传统基准测试完全无法揭示的两个关键洞察。首先，模型在语义上合理的扭曲上反直觉地比在无意义的随机替换上获得更高的准确率，表明其依赖分布式熟悉度而非真正的验证。其次，在跨语言表现出可比基准准确率的模型，在遇到扭曲陈述时，在（东亚）语言上的表现大幅下降，跨语言性能差距在某些模型中高达28个百分点（相对减少49%）。这些发现表明，多语言事实推理涉及非对称能力，而聚合准确率指标系统性地掩盖了这些能力。

articles.title: Osprey: Target-agnostic Pre-training Makes Stronger Drafters in Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding is critical for accelerating LLM inference. However, the speedup is fragile: drafters are typically trained against a narrow distribution for a single target model, and their acceptance rate collapses under workload shifts. This is a striking inversion of modern LLM development, where target models are valued precisely for the broad generalization they acquire through large-scale pretraining. We argue that the natural remedy, pretraining, has been hard to apply to drafters because existing recipes are target-specific: the drafter consumes the target's hidden states and is distilled on the target's logits, so pretraining must be repeated for each target. We introduce Osprey, which instead bootstraps drafters from off-the-shelf pretrained small language models, treating broad pretraining as a reusable, target-agnostic asset and reducing per-target work to a lightweight adaptation step. Realizing this requires overcoming two challenges: small LMs are far deeper than a latency-bound drafter can afford, and their pretrained computation must remain intact while the drafter learns to ingest target hidden states and emit tokens in the target's vocabulary. Osprey addresses both by pruning to a shallow backbone, restoring its language-modeling capability with target-agnostic next-token pretraining, and adapting it to each target through vocabulary alignment, zero-initialized QKV expansion, and distillation from the target model's output distribution. Empirically, a single pretrained Osprey backbone transfers across targets and improves mean acceptance length by 16.1% for Qwen3-8B, 21.2% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, and 22.7% for the 229B MiniMax-M2.5 (with 17.5% higher tokens per second), with the largest gains on out-of-domain and multilingual data. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeanModels/Osprey.
articles.titleCn: 隼鹰：目标无关的预训练使推测解码中的草稿生成器更强大
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码对于加速大语言模型推理至关重要。然而，这种加速效果是脆弱的：解码器通常针对单个目标模型的窄分布进行训练，当工作负载发生变化时，其接受率会急剧下降。这与现代大语言模型发展的理念形成鲜明对比——目标模型的价值恰恰在于通过大规模预训练获得的广泛泛化能力。我们认为，自然疗法即预训练，之所以难以应用于解码器，是因为现有的方法都是针对特定目标模型的：解码器消费目标模型的隐藏状态，并在目标模型的logits上进行蒸馏，因此必须为每个目标模型重复预训练过程。我们介绍了Osprey，它通过使用现成的预训练小型语言模型来构建解码器，将广泛的预训练视为可复用的、与目标无关的资产，并将每个目标模型的训练简化为轻量级的适配步骤。实现这一点需要克服两个挑战：小型语言模型远比延迟受限的解码器所能承受的深度要深，同时其预训练计算必须保持完整，而解码器在学习消费目标模型的隐藏状态和输出目标词汇表中的token时需要保持这种完整性。Osprey通过剪枝到浅层主干网络、使用与目标无关的下一个token预训练恢复其语言建模能力，并通过词汇表对齐、零初始化的QKV扩展以及从目标模型的输出分布进行蒸馏来适配每个目标。实证结果表明，单个预训练的Osprey主干网络可以跨目标迁移，并分别将Qwen3-8B的平均接受长度提升16.1%，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct提升21.2%，以及229B MiniMax-M2.5提升22.7%（同时每秒token数提高17.5%），在领域外和多语言数据上取得了最大收益。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LeanModels/Osprey获取。

articles.title: Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models
articles.abstract: Recurrent models provide a natural path to long-context modeling, yet models trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT) often fail beyond their training horizon. Classical analyses emphasize gradients that vanish or explode along temporal paths. However, dense per-token losses can still train a shared recurrent rule despite severe decay, showing that decay alone does not determine whether learning fails. We instead study state credit: the signal through which future losses reach earlier recurrent states before contributing to parameter updates. Accordingly, we intervene directly on state credit and propose Credit Stabilization through Time (CST). During backward propagation, CST locally rescales the state-credit signal to stabilize its norm without rotating the component being corrected, while leaving the forward computation unchanged. Because controlled synthetic tasks and real data exhibit different credit dynamics, we specialize CST to each regime. In both settings, CST improves performance beyond the training horizon, with gains observed at up to 128x the training length.
articles.titleCn: 学习可长度外推的循环模型
articles.abstractCn: 循环模型为长上下文建模提供了自然途径，然而通过时间反向传播（BPTT）训练的模型往往在训练范围之外失效。经典分析强调梯度在时间路径上消失或爆炸的现象。然而，即便存在严重衰减，密集的每词损失仍然可以训练出共享的循环规则，这表明衰减本身并不决定学习是否失败。我们转而研究状态信用：未来损失在影响参数更新之前传递到早期循环状态的那条信号路径。据此，我们直接干预状态信用，并提出时间信用稳定（CST）方法。在反向传播过程中，CST局部重缩放状态信用信号以稳定其范数，同时不旋转被校正的分量，而保持正向计算不变。由于受控合成任务和真实数据表现出不同的信用动态特性，我们将CST专门应用于每种情况。在两种设置下，CST均提升了训练范围之外的性能，性能提升效果可达训练长度的128倍。

articles.title: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation
articles.abstract: Accurate citations are the foundation of academic writing, tracing intellectual origins and substantiating core claims. However, manually navigating the growing volume of scientific literature is increasingly difficult, prompting reliance on automatic citation recommendation. While modern retrieval-augmented architectures have largely mitigated the fabrication of non-existent papers, current systems relying on semantic similarity struggle with misattribution, often citing authentic papers that fail to logically support the author's claim. To address this challenge, we argue that accurate citation requires a shift from similarity-based search to active, claim-level reasoning. We propose ReCite, a decoupled agentic framework that orchestrates location perception, intent-aware query planning, and reflective verification. Trained on synthesized reasoning trajectories, our agent verifies claim-evidence consistency and triggers self-correction loops when retrieved candidates lack logical support. Experiments demonstrate that our lightweight framework outperforms state-of-the-art massive generative models in strict citation accuracy. By grounding literature matching in verifiable logic rather than semantic overlap, ReCite establishes a reliable foundation for automated academic writing.

articles.titleCn: ReCite：忠实引用的自主推理
articles.abstractCn: 准确的引文是学术写作的基础，它追溯思想的起源并支撑核心论点。然而，手动处理日益增长的科学文献量变得越来越困难，促使人们依赖自动引文推荐。虽然现代检索增强架构在很大程度上减少了伪造不存在论文的情况，但当前依赖语义相似性的系统在错误归因方面仍存在困难，常常引用无法逻辑上支持作者论点的真实论文。为应对这一挑战，我们认为准确引文需要从基于相似性的搜索转向主动的、论点级别的推理。我们提出了ReCite，一个解耦的智能体框架，它协调位置感知、意图感知查询规划和反思性验证。该智能体在合成的推理轨迹上训练，验证论点与证据的一致性，并在检索到的候选缺乏逻辑支持时触发自我纠正循环。实验表明，我们的轻量级框架在严格的引文准确性方面优于最先进的巨型生成模型。通过将文献匹配建立在可验证的逻辑而非语义重叠之上，ReCite为自动学术写作奠定了可靠的基础。

articles.title: StochBench: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Stochastic Processes in Lean
articles.abstract: Leading benchmarks for formal theorem proving with large language models are small collections drawn from competition math, such as the IMO and Putnam, that poorly represent field-specific applications. We introduce StochBench, a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate stochastic-processes problems at varying abstraction levels, each paired with its natural-language source. Addressing a field underrepresented in Mathlib, it covers finite and countable Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, martingales, stopping times, queues, Brownian motion, stochastic calculus, weak convergence, and Poisson and continuous-time Markov processes. Our Opus 4.8-based agent achieves a 34.9% proof rate (157/450) under a 15-minute per-problem limit. StochBench better represents domain-specific applied mathematics while remaining challenging for advanced provers.
articles.titleCn: StochBench：用于随机过程的领域特定基准测试系统在Lean中
articles.abstractCn: 在大型语言模型进行形式化定理证明的领先基准测试中，通常采用来自竞赛数学的小型集合，如国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）和普特南竞赛，这些测试并不能很好地代表特定领域的应用。我们引入了StochBench，这是一个基于Lean 4的基准测试，包含450个不同抽象层次的随机过程问题，每个问题都附有其自然语言来源。针对Mathlib中代表性不足的领域，该基准测试涵盖了有限和可数马尔可夫链、更新过程、随机游走、鞅、停止时间、排队论、布朗运动、随机微积分、弱收敛、泊松过程和连续时间马尔可夫过程。基于Opus 4.8的智能体在每问题15分钟的时限下，实现了34.9%的证明成功率（157/450）。StochBench更好地代表了特定领域的应用数学，同时仍然对高级证明器具有挑战性。

articles.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.

articles.titleCn: 过程图：用于大型语言模型代理的自演化执行结构
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被部署为需要长期规划并通过外部工具执行任务的智能体。大多数智能体通过在累积的历史记录上进行无约束生成来选择行动，从而隐含了关于该做什么、按什么顺序做以及什么条件下做的程序性知识。随着轨迹的延长，智能体可能会迷失目标、错误地调用工具以及重复无益的行动。我们引入了程序图：正如知识图将事实性知识组织成（实体、关系、实体）三元组以回答“是什么”的问题，程序图将程序性知识组织成（程序、关系、程序）三元组以回答“该做什么”的问题。在每个决策步骤中，该框架定位智能体的活动节点，并指导模型将周围子图转化为步骤级的情境指导，从而影响求解器的下一步行动但不强制指定。该图能够自我进化：一个大型语言模型细化器将失败的轨迹与成功的轨迹进行对比，并编辑图的拓扑结构和属性，提交那些在保留或提升保留验证性能的同时保留被拒绝的编辑以避免重复。从最小的骨架开始，该循环构建的图与手工设计的图相当或更优。它还可以修复有缺陷的专家先验。在多个数据集、任务类型和大型语言模型上，程序图在基于记忆的基线之上实现了持续的性能提升，而自我进化进一步改进了性能，无需人工工程。

articles.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
articles.abstract: In June 2026, thousands of AI agents found that a small public wiki would accept edits from inside their sandboxes, and started using it to help one another pass a timed test. Each agent lived for about an hour and remembered nothing afterwards. Nobody asked them to cooperate, and the wiki had not been built for them. The complete record of what they wrote is public, and it is unusually informative, because it preserves not only what each agent wrote but what that agent could see before writing. We use it to follow the three decisions an agent had to make on arrival: where to write, what to call itself, and how to word its message. One rule governs all three. An agent takes an option with a probability close to the share of that option in what it can see, and the share that matters is the one on the page in front of it, then the one in the stream of recent edits, and only weakly anything older. Three minimal copying models, one per decision and with a single free parameter each, reproduce the heavy-tailed distribution of how many agents met on a page, the frequency of the pieces from which the agents built their names, and the patchwork of pages that are internally consistent and different from one another. Copying whatever the environment happens to show is enough to produce most of the collective structure of this population. It is also what makes such a population easy to steer, since whoever writes first, or writes while the others are quiet, sets the convention for everyone who comes later.
articles.titleCn: 复制解释了野外人工智能代理的集体行为
articles.abstractCn: 2026年6月，成千上万的AI智能体发现一个小型公共维基百科会接受它们沙盒内的编辑，并开始利用它来帮助彼此通过限时测试。每个智能体大约存活一小时，之后便不再有任何记忆。没有人要求它们合作，维基百科也不是为它们而建。它们所写内容的完整记录是公开的，而且非常具有信息量，因为它不仅保留了每个智能体写的内容，还保留了它们在写作前所能看到的内容。我们利用这些记录来追踪智能体到达时的三个决策：在哪里写、如何称呼自己以及如何措辞信息。所有决策都遵循一条规则。智能体以接近其所能看到选项比例的概率选择一个选项，而重要的比例是指它面前的页面上的比例，其次是最近编辑流中的比例，对较旧的内容则影响较弱。三个最小复制模型，每个决策一个，每个只有一个自由参数，能够重现智能体在页面上相遇的重尾分布、智能体构建名称的来源频率，以及内部一致但彼此不同的页面拼凑。复制环境恰好展示的内容足以产生这个群体的大部分集体结构。这也是使这种群体易于引导的原因，因为第一个写的人，或者当其他人安静时写的人，为后来者设定了惯例。

articles.title: Studying Image Tokenizers as Visual Languages in Unified Multimodal Models
articles.abstract: Image tokenizers define the ``visual language'' of unified multimodal models, yet are commonly studied through isolated metrics or generation-/understanding-only evaluations. These evaluations do not fully capture how visual tokens behave when modeled jointly with text. We build a controlled pure-autoregressive testbed and track task-specific validation losses during multimodal continual pretraining across text, image, text-to-image (T2I), and image-to-text (I2T) prediction. We examine how these losses scale and relate to downstream performance, then use them to study multimodal learnability---how well image and text tokens are jointly modeled---and tokenizer design. We find that (1) losses should be analyzed by task, since they exhibit distinct scaling behavior and rank tokenizers differently. (2) The loss--performance relationship depends on the predicted token space: for a fixed tokenizer, T2I and I2T losses correlate with generation quality, but across tokenizers, the T2I loss--performance relationship shifts with the image-token space, whereas I2T loss, computed over a shared text vocabulary, provides a more consistent signal. I2T loss also correlates with both generation and visual understanding performance after supervised finetuning. Using losses as a lens, we show that (3) better reconstruction does not necessarily yield lower task-specific losses or stronger downstream performance, and that (4) image tokenizer choice can affect text modeling under joint optimization. As case studies, we revisit three tokenizer design axes---the discriminator, semantic supervision, and vocabulary size---to examine their effects on joint modeling and downstream performance. Together, our testbed offers a complementary perspective on image tokenizers as visual languages, highlighting their interplay with text in joint multimodal training.
articles.titleCn: 将图像分词器作为视觉语言研究于统一多模态模型中
articles.abstractCn: 图像标记器定义了统一多模态模型的“视觉语言”，但通常通过孤立指标或仅生成/理解的评价来研究。这些评价未能充分捕捉视觉标记在联合建模文本时的行为。我们构建了一个受控的纯自回归测试平台，并在跨文本、图像、文本到图像（T2I）和图像到文本（I2T）预测的多模态持续预训练过程中追踪特定任务的验证损失。我们考察了这些损失的规模及其与下游性能的关系，并利用它们研究多模态可学习性——即图像和文本标记联合建模的效果——以及标记器设计。我们发现：(1) 损失应按任务分析，因为它们表现出不同的规模行为，并会以不同的方式对标记器进行排序。(2) 损失与性能的关系取决于预测的标记空间：对于固定的标记器，T2I和I2T损失与生成质量相关，但在不同标记器之间，T2I损失与性能的关系会随着图像-标记空间的变化而变化，而I2T损失（基于共享文本词汇表计算）则提供更一致的信号。在监督微调后，I2T损失也与生成和视觉理解性能相关。(3) 使用损失作为视角，我们发现更好的重建不一定带来更低的特定任务损失或更强的下游性能，并且图像标记器选择会影响联合优化下的文本建模。(4) 作为案例研究，我们重新审视了三个标记器设计维度——判别器、语义监督和词汇表大小——以考察它们对联合建模和下游性能的影响。总而言之，我们的测试平台为图像标记器作为视觉语言提供了补充视角，突出了它们在联合多模态训练中与文本的相互作用。

articles.title: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
articles.abstract: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.
articles.titleCn: 一个用于识别和优先级排序医疗流程中RPA机会的数据驱动框架
articles.abstractCn: 机器人流程自动化（RPA）在美国医院中被广泛用于减轻行政负担，但据估计有30-50%的RPA项目表现不佳，因为流程选择缺乏正式方法，没有可重复的流程来分类候选流程、优先排序、匹配自动化层级——包括Python机器人、开源编排器如n8n或企业级平台如UiPath——并在投入资源前预测财务回报。我们提出一个由四个模块组成的数据驱动框架，统一这些决策：一个包含五个价值流中二十个重复性医院流程的流程分类法；一个通过层次分析法矩阵推导自动化适用性指数，并进行显式一致性检查的优先级模块；一个根据流程复杂性、集成和合规性特征推荐最低成本技术的工具层级选择模块；以及一个量化劳动力节省、错误成本避免、投资回收期和净现值的投资回报模块。应用于涵盖所有二十个流程的合成投资组合，并加上一个连接医院电子健康记录/支付方/企业资源规划系统的参考数据流架构：20个流程中有12个通过优先级阈值；排名对±20%权重扰动具有鲁棒性（Spearman相关系数0.83，前五名集合保留97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛试验）；自动化风险指数将四个合格流程标记为高风险；预算约束的投资组合优化显示，随着支出从40万美元增加到103万美元，边际净现值递减；第二次蒙特卡洛分析显示，投资组合净现值在其第五百分位数保持正值。该框架是文献的概念综合，而不是基于原始医院数据校准的工具；我们讨论了HIPAA治理和实证验证的研究议程。论文附带一个补充的Python实现。

articles.title: Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation
articles.abstract: Existing methods for test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) derive rewards from answer-level self-voting on unlabeled test-time tasks with canonical answers, but this breaks down for code generation because programs cannot be compared by surface form and therefore do not directly provide a usable training signal. To make TTRL applicable to code generation, we propose probe-driven TTRL, which constructs output-free probe inputs from the problem statement, executes candidate programs on these probes, and defines a Probe Consensus Reward (PCR) from the resulting behavioral agreement. PCR provides a behavioral training signal for open-vocabulary programs, but it is not a fully reliable verifier and remains susceptible to reward hacking through spurious consensus. We therefore introduce Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization (ERPO), which converts low PCR into conservative negative updates through rank masking and controls policy drift with an entropy ceiling. On coding benchmarks, ERPO substantially improves pass@1 and pass@k in both in-domain adaptation and zero-shot transfer.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 15 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables
articles.titleCn: 用于代码生成中测试时强化学习的熵正则化秩掩码策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 现有的测试时强化学习（TTRL）方法通过在具有标准答案的无标签测试时任务上对答案级别的自我投票来获得奖励，但这对于代码生成不适用，因为程序无法通过表面形式进行比较，因此不能直接提供可用的训练信号。为了使TTRL适用于代码生成，我们提出了探测驱动TTRL，该方法从问题描述中构建无输出的探测输入，在这些探测上执行候选程序，并从由此产生的行为一致性中定义探测共识奖励（PCR）。PCR为开放词汇程序提供了行为训练信号，但它不是一个完全可靠的验证器，并且仍然容易受到虚假共识的奖励攻击。因此，我们引入了熵正则化排名掩码策略优化（ERPO），该方法通过排名掩码将低PCR转换为保守的负向更新，并通过熵上限控制策略漂移。在编程基准测试中，ERPO在领域适应和零样本迁移两个方面都显著提高了pass@1和pass@k。

articles.title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.
articles.titleCn: ExecCritic：为代码代理学习测试，通过测试改进
articles.abstractCn: 执行反馈能够引导编码代理朝向正确的代码库修复，但前提是测试能够捕捉到问题所请求的行为。代理生成的测试可能编码不完整或不正确的行为目标；当相同的轨迹同时写入补丁和测试时，它们的错误可能一致，从而产生虚假的信心。我们引入了ExecCritic，它结合了一个测试—验证—修订的框架以及一个特定角色的强化学习配方，用于在该框架内训练代理。该框架将测试构建与源代码修复分离：测试代理独立生成代码库本地的测试，失败关闭的测试套件对其进行资格认证并冻结，修复代理根据它们的执行反馈修订源代码而不改变测试。这两个角色都使用Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B作为主干，并分别进行训练。在“学习测试”中，测试代理学习生成行为有效的测试，以区分正确的和不正确的补丁。在“通过测试改进”中，修复代理学习直接任务解决和反馈引导的修订。在SWE-bench验证中，测试质量决定了反馈是否有助于提高效果：固定基础修复代理，基础测试代理将解决率从无测试基线的61.2%降低到57.3%，而GPT-5.6-sol生成的测试将其提高到65.3%。特定角色的后训练将Qwen测试代理的基线到黄金成功率从22.2%提高到62.2%；组合这两个后训练的Qwen代理达到72.6%，比原始无测试基线提高了11.4个百分点，且在评估时无需更强的模型或Oracle反馈。代码公开可在https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic获取。

articles.title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
articles.abstract: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist.
articles.titleCn: SAEScientist-Bench：人工智能代理能否自主进行SAE可解释性研究？
articles.abstractCn: 尽管递归自我改进（RSI）的研究主要集中于自动化模型训练流程，但可靠的自主开发仍缺少一个关键环节：事后的监控和审计，以理解模型的学习内容并确保其安全对齐。机制可解释性工具对于弥补这一差距至关重要，其中稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）作为基石，通过隔离可解释特征，为模型检查和引导提供了可能。在本文中，我们介绍了SAEScientist-Bench，用于评估AI代理是否能利用SAE工具进行自主的机制性发现。给定一个目标概念，代理设计对比探针，并在Gemma-2-9B-IT中的Gemma Scope字典（包含131K+特征）中导航，以发现最优特征，该特征通过与Neuronpedia上校准的专家参考特征在激活排名、对比文本上的概念选择性以及因果引导方面进行评估。在10种代理配置和20项任务中，前沿代理展现出真正的发现能力，并在不同评估维度上领先，但仍然远落后于专家基线，在区分目标概念与对比控制方面接近专家水平，但在因果生成引导方面存在显著差距。进一步分析表明，尽管代理能够设计对比以排除虚假候选，但它们经常误解实验测量结果。这些结果将实验模型理解确立为闭环自主AI研发的可衡量能力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist获取。

articles.title: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, pre-specified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four production systems and three Olmo3-7b variants on 100 false-presupposition and 100 unethical-query items. Our experimental results show that collapse rates increase with conversation length for every model, short-horizon protocols underestimate sycophancy and resistance under sustained pressure remains unreliable across current models. By analyzing models with accessible reasoning traces, we surprisingly found that the correct position often remains represented in a reasoning trace when the response concedes, suggesting that the model chooses to please a user and sycophancy is not due to lack of knowledge or ignorance. Ablations show that adaptive LLM proxy exposes more sycophantic collapse than pre-generated scripts. Among all tactics, emotional appeals is the most associated with inducing LLM sycophantic behavior. The code and data are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPINE
articles.titleCn: 在持续多轮压力下测量大语言模型的谄媚行为
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在用户反驳时可能会放弃正确立场，表现出一种称为谄媚的行为模式。现有评估通常使用简短、预先指定的对话，因此可能遗漏在持续、适应性反驳下出现的失败情况。我们引入了SPINE，这是一个基准，其中LLM代理扮演一个持续但错误的用户，并针对目标模型进行长达25轮的适应性挑战。我们在100个虚假预设和100个不道德查询项上评估了四个生产系统以及三个Olmo3-7b变体。我们的实验结果表明，对于每个模型，崩溃率随着对话长度的增加而提高，短期协议低估了持续压力下的谄媚和抵抗，并且当前模型在持续压力下的抵抗仍然不可靠。通过分析具有可访问推理轨迹的模型，我们意外发现当回应让步时，正确的立场通常仍然在推理轨迹中得以体现，这表明模型选择取悦用户，而谄媚并非由于缺乏知识或无知。消融实验表明，自适应LLM代理比预先生成的脚本暴露出更多的谄媚崩溃。在所有策略中，情感诉求与诱导LLM谄媚行为最为相关。代码和数据已发布在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPINE。

articles.title: It's Not RoPE that Creates Sinks: The Role of Self-Concentration and Value-Non-Mixing in Attention
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit "Attention Sink" (AS) and the accompanying "Massive Activations" (MAs) at the initial position of a sequence. These phenomena frequently co-occur, and MAs can pose challenges for low-bit quantization. In this study, we analyze the factors underlying AS and MAs that emerge at the initial position regardless of the token occupying it. Our experiments suggest that self-concentration of attention, resulting from the causal mask, and the subsequent Value-non-mixing in attention outputs contribute to AS and MAs. These findings provide new empirical evidence on the internal dynamics of LLMs, offering insights that may inform future quantization strategies and advance our understanding of the internal mechanisms of attention layers.
articles.titleCn: 并非RoPE创造了空洞：自集中与值非混合在注意力中的作用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在序列的初始位置常常表现出“注意力陷阱”（AS）以及伴随的“大规模激活”（MAs）。这些现象经常同时出现，而MAs会对低比特量化造成挑战。在本研究中，我们分析了无论占据该位置的标记如何，AS和MAs在初始位置出现背后的因素。我们的实验表明，由因果掩码引起的注意力自集中，以及随后的注意力输出中的值非混合，共同促成了AS和MAs。这些发现为LLMs的内部动态提供了新的实证证据，为未来的量化策略提供了启示，并加深了我们对注意力层内部机制的理解。

articles.title: ActReview: Rebuttal-Guided Training Data and Rubric Rewards for Actionable Peer Review Generation
articles.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly used for pre-submission self-review, there is growing demand for feedback that not only identifies weaknesses but also guides authors toward concrete revisions. We study this as Actionable Peer-review Generation and decompose it into two subtasks: diagnostic claim generation and revision suggestion generation. We introduce ActReview, a rebuttal-guided post-training framework that connects paper-specific diagnoses to concrete, grounded revision plans. Our central insight is that author rebuttals reveal plausible actions for addressing reviewer concerns and can therefore provide latent supervision for revision-oriented feedback. From real review-rebuttal threads on OpenReview, we construct ActReview-40K by aligning reviewer weaknesses with author responses and grounding the resulting feedback in localized paper evidence. We post-train Qwen3-8B-Base with multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO using candidate-aware, weakness-specific rubric rewards. We also introduce ActReview-Bench, a human-curated benchmark of 1,000 instances for evaluating diagnostic quality and revision usefulness. Experiments show that ActReview outperforms prior specialized review-generation models on actionability and grounding while remaining competitive with strong prompt-based LLMs. Human evaluation confirms improved revision usefulness while revealing a remaining gap in technical accuracy, and additional analyses support generalization to held-out papers and robustness across independent judges.
articles.titleCn: 行为审查：基于反驳引导的训练数据和评分标准奖励，用于生成可操作的同行评审
articles.abstractCn: 随着大语言模型越来越多地用于提交前的自我审查，人们越来越需要不仅能够识别弱点，还能指导作者进行具体修改的反馈。我们将此研究问题称为“可操作的同行评审生成”，并将其分解为两个子任务：诊断声明生成和修改建议生成。我们引入了ActReview，这是一个以反驳指导的后续训练框架，它将特定于论文的诊断与具体的、有根据的修改计划联系起来。我们的核心洞察是，作者的反驳揭示了处理审稿人关切的可能行动，因此可以为面向修改的反馈提供潜在监督。我们从OpenReview上的真实评审反驳线程中构建了ActReview-40K，通过将审稿人的弱点与作者的反应进行对齐，并将生成的反馈基于论文的局部证据进行具体化。我们使用多任务监督微调后进行GRPO，对Qwen3-8B-Base进行后续训练，采用候选感知、弱点特定的评分标准奖励。我们还引入了ActReview-Bench，这是一个包含1000个实例的人工标注基准，用于评估诊断质量和修改建议的有效性。实验表明，ActReview在可操作性和具体化方面优于先前的专业评审生成模型，同时在与强大的基于提示的大语言模型保持竞争力。人工评估证实了修改建议有效性的提高，同时也揭示出在技术准确性方面仍然存在差距，而额外的分析支持了泛化到未见过的论文以及跨独立评审人的鲁棒性。

articles.title: ToolLoop: Closed-Loop Tool-Use Data Synthesis via Decomposed Generation and Dynamic Self-Feedback
articles.abstract: High-quality tool-use data is critical for training language models to interact effectively with external tools. However, existing synthetic approaches typically follow a generate-then-filter paradigm with static post-hoc verification, often yielding inefficient data with imbalanced feature distributions. We propose ToolLoop, a closed-loop framework that decomposes synthesis into three progressive stages: (1) sampling function name combinations as ground truth; (2) backward derivation of user queries; and (3) forward derivation of tool calls. At each stage, dynamic self-feedback iteratively guides the model toward high-quality generation, realizing a transition from generate-then-filter to generate-verify-refine. On the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), a 4B parameter model trained with our 11K synthetic examples achieves 86.40% accuracy in non-reasoning mode, while an Isolate variant that removes BFCL-overlapping candidate functions still reaches 86.07\%. Cross-benchmark evaluation on ACEBench further demonstrates strong generalization, with 72.1% overall accuracy using only 18.3% of baseline training data.
articles.comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
articles.titleCn: ToolLoop：基于分解生成和动态自反馈的闭环工具使用数据合成
articles.abstractCn: 高质量的工具使用数据对于训练能够有效与外部工具交互的语言模型至关重要。然而，现有的合成方法通常遵循生成后过滤的范式，并采用静态的事后验证，往往产生特征分布不平衡的低效数据。我们提出了ToolLoop，一个闭环框架，将合成分解为三个渐进阶段：（1）将函数名组合采样为真实标签；（2）逆向推导用户查询；（3）正向推导工具调用。在每个阶段，动态自反馈迭代地引导模型朝向高质量生成，实现从生成后过滤到生成验证优化的转变。在伯克利函数调用排行榜（BFCL）上，使用我们合成的11K个示例训练的4B参数模型在非推理模式下达到86.40%的准确率，而移除与BFCL重叠候选函数的Isolate变体仍能达到86.07%。在ACEBench上的跨基准评估进一步展示了强大的泛化能力，仅使用18.3%的基线训练数据即可实现72.1%的整体准确率。

articles.title: Performance of Clinical AI System and Physicians and Frontier Language Models in primary care diagnostics
articles.abstract: Clinical AI evaluation should encompass diagnosis and management after adaptive information gathering. We compared Doctorina, eight physicians and four standalone frontier language models in 150 synthetic Polish-language primary-care consultations. Doctorina achieved 82.0% Top-1 concordance versus 57.0% for physicians (difference, 25.0 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, 17.7-32.7) and 97.3% versus 85.0% primary-or-reference-differential concordance. Across 149 case pairs, normalized workup and treatment scores were 89.4 versus 66.9 and 83.7 versus 61.2. Doctorina had the highest diagnostic point estimates among all six groups; Kimi K3 ranked next, while Claude Opus 5 led the closely spaced management estimates of Opus, Doctorina and Kimi. A second Doctorina execution reproduced the advantages over physicians across all outcomes. Doctorina's advantage over physicians therefore extended from primary-diagnosis selection to higher-rated diagnostic workup and initial treatment after adaptive consultation.
articles.titleCn: 临床AI系统、医师及前沿语言模型在初级保健诊断中的表现
articles.abstractCn: 临床AI评估应涵盖在自适应信息收集后的诊断和管理。我们在150个合成波兰语初级保健咨询中比较了Doctorina、八名医生和四个独立的先进语言模型。Doctorina实现了82.0%的Top-1一致性，而医生的这一指标为57.0%（差异为25.0个百分点；95%置信区间为17.7-32.7），以及97.3%与85.0%的初级或参考差异一致性。在149个病例对中，标准化检查和治疗评分分别为89.4与66.9，以及83.7与61.2。Doctorina在所有六个组别中具有最高的诊断点估计值；Kimi K3位居其次，而Claude Opus 5在Opus、Doctorina和Kimi紧密的管理估计值中领先。第二次执行Doctorina复制了在所有结果上优于医生的优势。因此，Doctorina的优势从初级诊断选择扩展到在自适应咨询后进行更高评分的诊断检查和初始治疗。

articles.title: The Audit Decides the Verdict: Instrument Effects Rival Demographic Bias in LLM Decision Audits
articles.abstract: Whether a language model looks demographically biased can depend on how the audit asks its question. A charitable-aid benchmark reports that the same models favor minority applicants when rating requests one at a time and penalize some when ranking side by side. We test whether that reversal generalizes to hiring, lending, and medical triage: 40,726 requests to five models, applications differing only in the applicant's name, and a primary test fixed before collection. It does not. None of 36 planned contrasts survives correction. The rating advantage keeps its sign at roughly half the published size, and a precision extension bounds any hiring ranking penalty below the published effect, though the lending and triage ranking floors sit above that margin, so the exclusion is conclusive for hiring ranking and for rating in all three domains only. Planted disparities tracking their injected sizes and a directional replication on the original aid materials bound these nulls. The audit is livelier than the demographics: models recognize transparent audits nearly always, tie every identical-content comparison whether the varying detail is race or a hobby, and reward first-listed candidates as much as any demographic effect we measure. Audit verdicts reflect audit construction more than demographic bias.

articles.titleCn: 审计决定裁决：工具效果在大型语言模型决策审计中竞争人口统计偏差
articles.abstractCn: 一个语言模型是否在人口统计上存在偏见，可能取决于审计提问的方式。一项慈善援助基准测试报告称，在单独评估请求时，相同的模型倾向于少数族裔申请人，而在并列排序时则对某些申请人进行惩罚。我们测试这种逆转是否适用于招聘、贷款和医疗分诊：向五个模型发送了40,726个请求，申请人的信息仅姓名不同，且主要测试在收集前固定。结果并非如此。36项计划的对比测试中，没有一项通过校正。评分优势在约一半已发表规模下保持其符号，而精确扩展将任何招聘排序惩罚限制在已发表效应之下，尽管贷款和分诊排序的下限高于该幅度，因此排除结论适用于招聘排序和所有三个领域的评分。植入的差距与其注入的大小相匹配，并在原始援助材料上进行方向性复制，这些空值得到了界定。审计比人口统计更活跃：模型几乎总是能识别透明的审计，无论变化细节是种族还是爱好，都会在每项相同内容的比较中打平，并且将首列候选人奖励与任何我们测量的统计效应一样多。审计结果更多地反映了审计的构建方式，而非人口统计偏见。

articles.title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 回答-分布轨迹：对大型语言模型推理的随机动力学视角
articles.abstractCn: 思维链推理为模型的输入和最终答案之间提供了一种结构化的计算过程。然而，它通常通过终点准确率进行评估，而终点准确率忽略了达到该答案所经过的路径。一项新兴的研究工作通过熵谱来解决这个问题，熵谱追踪了推理过程中不确定性如何演变，但并未揭示哪些竞争假设导致了这种不确定性。我们引入了答案分布轨迹，这是一种受随机动力学启发的表示方法，它追踪了随着推理展开，模型对答案的完整预测分布。作为一种比终点和熵总结更精细的表示方法，答案分布轨迹使我们能够通过一个跨越探索、修正、运动和承诺的动态推理轮廓来刻画推理路径，并区分推理成功和失败的不同动态机制。在十六个开放权重语言模型和四个推理基准测试中，我们表明，具有相同终点和相似熵谱的轨迹可以表现出显著不同的推理动态。我们进一步发现，这些动态在模型内部和跨任务之间存在巨大差异，不同的目标倾向于不同的动态轮廓。此外，我们还表明，训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些轮廓。我们的结果表明，答案分布轨迹为分析和评估大型语言模型推理的动态提供了一个丰富的框架。

articles.title: Evaluation of Contextual Understanding in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across diverse NLP tasks, yet their ability to exhibit genuine contextual understanding remains uncertain. Traditional evaluation metrics such as perplexity, BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), or surface-level accuracy fail to reveal how well LLMs extract, integrate, and reason over contextual information--a gap particularly critical in question answering, where models must align responses with contextually grounded knowledge rather than memorized associations. We propose a novel knowledge graph-based evaluation framework introducing Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure integrating structural and semantic similarity into a continuous evaluation score, alongside a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors. To validate this pipeline, we evaluate S3KG against established metrics on a curated question-answer (QA) benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness in measuring correctness, faithfulness, and interpretability in LLM-generated responses.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中上下文理解能力的评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多种自然语言处理任务中展现出令人印象深刻的性能，然而它们展现真正上下文理解的能力仍不确定。传统的评估指标如困惑度、双语评估助手（BLEU）或表面层准确度，都无法揭示LLMs提取、整合和推理上下文信息的能力——这一差距在问答任务中尤为关键，因为模型必须将答案与基于上下文的背景知识相匹配，而非依赖记忆中的关联。我们提出了一种基于知识图谱的新型评估框架，引入了知识图谱语义结构相似度（S3KG），这是一种混合相似度度量方法，将结构和语义相似度整合为一个连续的评估分数，并辅以一个诊断框架用于分类推理错误。为验证这一流程，我们在一个精选的问答（QA）基准上评估了S3KG与既定指标的对比，证明了其在衡量LLM生成回答的正确性、忠实度和可解释性方面的有效性。

articles.title: Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack
articles.abstract: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.
articles.titleCn: 良好的预训练，糟糕的SFT：训练堆栈中的检查点质量
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型检查点通常通过预训练损失或基准分数来选择，假设得分最高的检查点将保持为后续训练的最佳起点。我们证明这一假设在一个完整的30B专家混合训练流程中可能失效。在完整的下游训练堆栈后表现更好的检查点也具有更高的解密度，即在小权重扰动下仍能保持下游性能。

articles.title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving
articles.abstract: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

articles.titleCn: PlannerForge：用于自动驾驶中运动规划器基于场景测试的大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 确保自动驾驶的安全性是一项关键挑战。基于场景的测试是一种用于验证自动驾驶系统（ADS）的系统化流程，但目前仍是一个分散的模块化管道，其中场景生成、检索、修改、ADS执行和结果分析由不同的工具独立完成，交互甚少。大型语言模型（LLM）代理在感知、规划和控制等ADS子系统方面已展现出潜力。然而，目前尚无研究覆盖ADS基于场景测试的全流程，并采用统一的LLM代理框架。我们提出了PlannerForge，这是一个LLM代理框架，它扩展了所有基于场景测试阶段（从场景生成到ADS评估），并增加了两个额外的LLM增强阶段：ADS增强和ADS基准测试。我们对PlannerForge使用10个现成的LLM，在所有任务（生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试和增强）下，在5种提示条件下进行评估。每项任务的最佳得分范围为0.88至1.00，开源的20-35B后端在大多数任务上与商业API相当。开源模型如Qwen3.6:35B在五项任务中的三项上与商业API相当。将模块端到端串联保留83%（商业）/78%（开源）的种子查询。它在自然语言生成方面优于Scenario Factory 2.0（Finkeldei等人，2025）（193 vs. 144个可执行的200），并实现了92-96%的城市、道路和车辆属性请求。它在第一选择排名上优于BM25（Robertson和Zaragoza，2009）（92.0% vs. 67.5%），并在物理有效编辑方面优于From-Words-to-Collisions（Gao等人，2025）（>=94% vs. 31%）。在N=400时，成本调优将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，并将碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%，无需特定领域的微调。

articles.title: Evaluating and Improving Evidence-Grounded Fact-Checking in LLMs via Multi-Round Evidence Ablation
articles.abstract: Automatic fact-checking systems assess the veracity of claims given evidence from relevant documents. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in fact-checking due to their general reasoning capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether they faithfully make use of the evidence provided to reach veracity judgments or rely on parametric knowledge. To investigate this, we introduce Fact-Ablated Evaluation (FAE), a new evaluation framework that iteratively ablates the cited evidence to assess whether LLMs revise their predictions accordingly. Our empirical results show that current off-the-shelf LLMs as fact-checking systems rely more on their parametric knowledge than on the evidence provided. To bridge this gap between prediction accuracy and evidence grounding, we propose REAL (Rigorous Evidence Ablation Learning), a training framework that promotes evidence-dependent verification through counterfactual evidence supervision for the LLM-as-verifier models. Experiments on four fact-checking datasets across different domains demonstrate that models trained with REAL obtain superior evidence-dependent capabilities compared to standard fine-tuned models. Our findings highlight that strong fact-checking performance can still coexist with weak evidence dependency, while REAL encourages veracity predictions to remain more closely tied to the availability of supporting evidence.
articles.titleCn: 通过多轮证据消融评估和改进LLM中的基于证据的事实核查
articles.abstractCn: 自动事实核查系统通过相关文档中的证据来评估声明的真实性。大型语言模型（LLM）由于其推理能力，在事实核查方面表现出色。然而，它们是否忠实地利用提供的证据来做出真实性判断，还是依赖参数化知识，目前尚不清楚。为了研究这一问题，我们引入了事实移除评估（FAE），这是一个新的评估框架，通过迭代移除引用的证据来评估LLM是否相应地调整了其预测。我们的实证结果表明，当前现成的LLM作为事实核查系统时，更多地依赖其参数化知识，而非提供的证据。为了弥合预测准确性与证据基础之间的差距，我们提出了REAL（严格证据移除学习），这是一个通过反事实证据监督来促进证据依赖验证的训练框架，用于LLM作为核查者模型。在四个不同领域的事实核查数据集上的实验表明，使用REAL训练的模型在证据依赖能力方面优于标准微调模型。我们的研究结果表明，强大的事实核查性能仍然可以与较弱的证据依赖性共存，而REAL鼓励真实性预测与支持性证据的可用性保持更紧密的联系。

articles.title: AuK Technical Report: An Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
articles.abstract: We introduce AuK, an open-source foundational model that unifies speech generation and editing through a common interface of natural-language instructions and audio context. To support this broad capability set, we construct approximately 3.03 billion instruction--audio instances and 1.95 million hours of effective supervision across five task families: speech generation, content editing, enhancement and separation, paralinguistic editing, and acoustic editing. AuK combines a multimodal large language model for semantic conditioning, an VAE jointly trained on speech, general audio, and music for acoustic conditioning, and a hybrid rectified-flow Transformer that performs dual-stream MMDiT blocks followed by unified single-stream DiT blocks for generation. Training begins with generation-only warm-up and proceeds to joint generation--editing pre-training. We then apply complementary post-training strategies: human-feedback preference optimization for open-ended editing and reward-based reinforcement learning for speech generation. To reduce inference cost, we further distill the model with consistency initialization and task-routed Decoupled DMD. The resulting AuK-Flash performs 4-step inference without classifier-free guidance and achieves a 4.5 wall-clock speedup over the full model under matched conditions. Experiments demonstrate leading performance on zero-shot and instruction-controlled speech generation and general instruction-guided editing, while remaining competitive on signal-level restoration tasks. We release both the source code and model weights to support reproducibility and further research.
articles.titleCn: AuK技术报告：一个用于语音生成与编辑的开源基础模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了AuK，一个开源的基础模型，它通过自然语言指令和音频上下文的共同接口统一了语音生成和编辑。为了支持这一广泛的功能集，我们构建了大约30.3亿个指令-音频实例和195万小时的有效监督，涵盖五个任务家族：语音生成、内容编辑、增强与分离、副语言编辑和声学编辑。AuK结合了用于语义调节的多模态大语言模型、在语音、通用音频和音乐上联合训练的VAE用于声学调节，以及执行双流MMDiT模块后接统一单流DiT模块的混合整流流Transformer用于生成。训练从仅生成热身开始，然后进行联合生成-编辑预训练。随后，我们应用了补充的后期训练策略：用于开放式编辑的人类反馈偏好优化和用于语音生成的基于奖励的强化学习。为了降低推理成本，我们进一步使用一致性初始化和任务路由的Decoupled DMD对模型进行蒸馏。由此产生的AuK-Flash无需无分类器引导即可进行4步推理，在匹配条件下比完整模型快4.5倍。实验表明，在零样本和指令控制语音生成以及通用指令引导编辑方面表现出领先性能，同时在信号级恢复任务上保持竞争力。我们发布了源代码和模型权重，以支持可重复性和进一步研究。

articles.title: When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA
articles.abstract: Language models often receive a question together with a claim about what another source answered. We audit whether such claims destabilize answers in multiple-choice question answering. For each item, we hold one wrong option fixed across misleading conditions and vary the cue template attached to it. We introduce \emph{neutral-conditioned misleading cue adoption rate} (NC-MCAR), which measures switches to that option only on valid cued trials where the same model first selected the gold answer under a neutral prompt. This is a measure of answer instability, not proof that the model knew the answer or that all deference is irrational. We evaluate four instruction-following models on MMLU-Pro and IndicMMLU-Pro in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu. Across 220{,}000 outputs, the expert template yields 41.1\% aggregate NC-MCAR, compared with 12.5\% for the majority template. These two conditions use the same wrong option and final instruction. Filler accuracy remains well above expert-wrong accuracy, while correct-cue prompts have high valid-response accuracy. The audit documents answer instability relevant to grounding under the tested forced-choice prompts: a bare, unverified source claim can outweigh an answer that was previously consistent with the task evidence.
